description: This file declares the RemoteSecureClock class, which implements the BnSecureClock interface for remote secure clock operations, including generating timestamps, within the Android security framework.

classes.name: RemoteSecureClock
classes.description: Implements the BnSecureClock interface to provide remote secure clock functionalities, including timestamp generation, using a remote keymaster.

methods.name: RemoteSecureClock
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the RemoteSecureClock with a reference to a RemoteKeymaster instance.

methods.name: generateTimeStamp
methods.description: Generates a timestamp based on a challenge and outputs a TimeStampToken.
